title: [Master]-Incorrect project ledger costs when non-deductible VAT is posted to a foreign-currency project
summary: Fixed incorrect project ledger costs when posting non-deductible VAT to a foreign-currency project by correcting currency conversions in the non-deductible VAT implementation.
key_points: Non-deductible VAT now uses the correct LCY amount for local currency costs
Project currency amounts are properly converted from the source VAT amount
Corrects currency path handling without expanding scope of the fix
Affects job journal line processing for multi-currency scenarios
quote: The current code adds a project-currency amount to LCY cost and an LCY amount to project cost.
